args.sql:
SELECT LOWER(TRIM((p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class'))) AS dw_class, 
       CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('yes', 'y', 'available') THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS cable_active,
       COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM properties p
JOIN amenities a ON p.houselink = a.houseid
GROUP BY dw_class, cable_active
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
